text: Plain-language information for customer accounts, quotations, technology services, future goods sales, privacy, documents, delivery and consumer remedies.

Logged-in customers can access available builds, quotations, invoices, receipts, order records and service records through the customer account. Electronic copies do not remove any right to request records through a formal legal process where applicable.
VoltTech operates from Pretoria, Gauteng. The private residential operating address is not presented as a walk-in retail address.

These pages provide customer-facing information about VoltTech's current processes and policies. Applicable South African law prevails where a statutory right or obligation cannot lawfully be excluded or changed by policy wording.
